paragraphs.text: Deekah is a human wizard who serves as a professor at the Quandrix College within Strixhaven University, located on the plane of Arcavios .

Deekah perceives reality as a vast and intricate network of interlinked mathematical equations, a vision she regards as profoundly beautiful. She dedicates her studies to uncovering new theorems by bringing abstract mathematical concepts into tangible, physical forms. Her elegant and complex geometric constructs have become a notable and inspiring presence on campus, captivating students and faculty alike.
